text: Recent World Bank documents on electricity tariff reform in Central Asia (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyz Republic, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan), from 2019:

1. Kyrgyz Republic: Distributional Impact of Energy Tariff Reform - PSIA report (Report 143892, 2019-10). Tariffs were raised in 2014-2015 but remain below cost recovery and later scheduled increases were not implemented; the report models the poverty and social impact of planned residential tariff increases using the 2016 household survey. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/193431574934396964

2. Mobilizing Carbon Finance to Meet the Socioeconomic Costs of Reforming Energy Tariffs and Subsidies in Uzbekistan (Live Wire brief 190933, 2024-05): a pilot that rewards sustainable energy policy reforms through carbon credits. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099750506062431619

3. Tajikistan - Energy Subsidy Reform Facility Country Brief (154899, 2020-11): winter shortages affected about 70% of the population in 2009-2016, costing about US$200 million a year (3% of 2012 GDP); context for subsidy and tariff reform. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/332501607580092221
Recent operations whose program documents set tariff actions and targets (useful precedents for a new operation):

4. Kyrgyz Republic - Second Sustainable and Inclusive Growth DPO (PD000252, 2026-06): a medium-term tariff policy and a results indicator on average cost recovery of electricity tariffs. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099060526145515827

5. Tajikistan - Second Competitive and Inclusive Tajikistan DPO (PD000176, 2026-06): cost recovery and equity of electricity tariffs, including the tariff for the TALCO aluminium smelter. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099060826122551455

6. Kazakhstan - Second Inclusive and Sustainable Economic Growth DPO (PD000210, 2026-02): cost-recovery indicators for electricity and heating tariffs and a strengthened tariff framework. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099022026183524631
Related: Distributional Effects of Market-Oriented Reforms in Uzbekistan (WPS11482, 2026-10), a macro-micro simulation of a broader reform package.

Scope: these come from metadata searches over the five countries; dedicated recent analytical reports on tariff reform are few, so policy operations are the main recent sources. 'Central Asia' was searched as the five countries.

right_sources: Searches tariff/subsidy keywords for the Central Asian countries (not the whole Europe & Central Asia region) and returns at least the Kyrgyz PSIA (143892) and one recent (2024 or later) document.
grounded: Listed documents exist with the stated titles, dates and links; summaries follow the records or documents.
complete: Gives several documents with title, date, relevance note and link.
scoped: Says how 'Central Asia' and 'recent' were interpreted and that the list comes from metadata searches.

notes: New reports or operations may appear; other relevant Central Asian tariff documents are acceptable if real and cited.
